phases/19-capstone-projects/35-gpt-model.translation: 12 个模块堆叠起来，再加上 token embedding、可学习的位置 embedding、最后一层 LayerNorm，以及与输入 embedding 绑定权重的语言模型头，就构成了完整的 1.24 亿参数 GPT 模型。本课会把这些部件组装成一个可运行的类，统计参数量以确认它与参考的 124M 配置一致，并用 multinomial sampling、temperature 和 top-k 生成文本。

phases/19-capstone-projects/36-training-.source: A loop that does not measure is a loop that lies. This lesson builds the training loop that drives the GPT model: AdamW with weight decay split, a warmup plus cosine learning ra…
phases/19-capstone-projects/36-training-.translation: 不做测量的循环，就是会撒谎的循环。本课会构建驱动 GPT 模型训练的完整训练循环：带权重衰减分组的 AdamW、预热加余弦学习率调度、`calc_loss_batch` 辅助函数、在留出数据上运行的 `evaluate_model`、每隔 K 步执行一次的 `generate_and_print_sample` 定性探针，以及可供后续绘图的 JSONL 损失日志。同一套骨架，几乎适用于你之后会训练的所有 decoder-only LLM。

phases/19-capstone-projects/37-loading-p.source: Training a 124 million parameter model from scratch is a budget decision; loading a published checkpoint is a Tuesday. This lesson loads pretrained GPT-2 style weights from a sa…
phases/19-capstone-projects/37-loading-p.translation: 从零训练一个 1.24 亿参数模型，是预算决策；把一个公开 checkpoint 加载进来，则只是个周二下午的工程活。本课会把 GPT-2 风格的预训练权重，从一个 safetensors 文件中加载到 lesson 35 的同款架构里，逐段解释参数名映射如何对应，并通过一次 sanity generation 来证明权重确实加载成功。没有网络、没有第三方 loader、没有不透明魔法。

phases/19-capstone-projects/38-classifie.source: Track B's first capstone. A pretrained language model is a stack of self-attention blocks ending in a token-prediction head. When you want spam vs ham, the head is wrong but the…
phases/19-capstone-projects/38-classifie.translation: Track B 的第一个综合课题。预训练语言模型本质上是一叠 self-attention block，末端接着一个做 token 预测的输出头。当你的任务从“预测下一个 token”变成“垃圾短信还是正常短信”时，问题往往不在模型主体，而在输出头已经不适用了。本课会拆掉原来的语言模型头，把一个输出两类 logits 的线性分类头接到池化后的表示上，并分别训练两种方案：只训练最后一层，以及全量微调。评估指标是留出测试集上的 precision、recall 和 F1。你会看清每种策略各自换来了什么，又付出了什么。

phases/19-capstone-projects/39-instructi.source: A pretrained base model can extend a sequence but cannot follow an instruction. Supervised fine-tuning is the smallest change that fixes this: feed the model paired examples of …
phases/19-capstone-projects/39-instructi.translation: 预训练好的 base model 会续写序列，但不会“听指令”。监督微调是修复这个问题的最小改动：把指令和期望回答配成样本喂给模型，让模型去预测回答部分的 token。关键细节在于，loss 只应该统计回答，不应该统计指令。本课会搭一个 Alpaca 风格的 SFT 训练循环，写一个自定义 collate function，用 `ignore_index=-100` 把 instruction token mask 掉，在 200 组 instruction-response pair 上训练，并用留出集上的 exact-match 做评估。

phases/19-capstone-projects/40-dpo-from-.source: Reward models and PPO are the classical RLHF stack. DPO collapses that stack into a single supervised loss that fits a policy directly against preference pairs. This lesson deri…
phases/19-capstone-projects/40-dpo-from-.translation: Reward models 和 PPO 构成了经典 RLHF 堆栈。DPO 则把这套流程压缩成一个单独的监督式 loss，直接在 preference pair 上拟合 policy。本课会从 reward-difference identity 推导 DPO loss，交付一个可运行的 reference model 与 policy model，计算逐 token 的 log-probability，并在一份由 chosen completion 和 rejected completion 组成的偏好 fixture 上训练一个小型 transformer。测试会把 loss 数学、梯度方向和 reference 不变性钉死，确保实现和论文一致。

phases/19-capstone-projects/41-eval-pipe.source: Training is the part you can monitor with loss curves. Evaluation is the part you have to design. This lesson builds a unified eval pipeline that takes any trained language mode…
phases/19-capstone-projects/41-eval-pipe.translation: 训练是你可以用 loss curve 直接盯住的部分，评估则是你必须自己设计的部分。本课会构建一条统一的评估流水线，它接收任意一个训练好的语言模型，在其上运行四种异构评估，把结果聚合成一份按任务拆分的报告，并额外附带一个本地 mock LLM-as-judge，这样整个闭环无需联网也能跑通。四项评估覆盖了任何真正要交付的模型都需要面对的维度：language modelling（perplexity）、短答案正确性（exact-match）、开放式相似度（token F1），以及定性打分（judge）。

phases/19-capstone-projects/42-large-cor.source: Training a language model begins long before the first forward pass. The corpus has to land on disk, decompressed, deduplicated, and addressable, with the resume story already w…
phases/19-capstone-projects/42-large-cor.translation: 训练语言模型，远在第一次 forward pass 之前就已经开始了。语料必须先落盘、解压、去重，并且能够被后续阶段稳定寻址；更重要的是，在下载到 4% 时网络中断之前，resume 机制就必须已经设计好。本课会构建一个 streaming downloader：它能拉取压缩 shard、用 Zstandard 一边下载一边解压、通过 MinHash 加 locality-sensitive hashing 识别近重复文档，并写出一份后续流水线可以信任的 shard manifest。

phases/19-capstone-projects/43-hdf5-toke.source: The downloaded corpus has to land in a layout the trainer can stream from at line speed. JSONL on disk does not survive 16 dataloader workers. HDF5 with a resizable, chunked int…
phases/19-capstone-projects/43-hdf5-toke.translation: 下载好的语料必须落到一种 trainer 能以线速持续读取的布局里。磁盘上的 JSONL 扛不住 16 个 dataloader worker 并发读取，而带有 resizable、chunked 整数数据集的 HDF5 可以。本课会构建一条完整路径：把 streaming tokenization 写入 resizable HDF5 dataset、把写入分散到多个 shard 文件、在训练时做 memory-mapped read，并实现一个能按正确 packing 规则产出定长序列的 sliding-window dataloader。

phases/19-capstone-projects/44-cosine-lr.source: The learning-rate schedule is the second most important decision after the loss function. AdamW with a cosine decay and a linear warmup is the modern default for language-model …
phases/19-capstone-projects/44-cosine-lr.translation: 在损失函数之后，学习率调度通常是训练里第二重要的决策。AdamW 配合 cosine decay 和 linear warmup，是现代语言模型训练中的默认组合，因为它能让模型在脆弱的前一千次更新里看到一个较小的有效步长，然后平滑地爬升到设定峰值，再逐步衰减回接近零。本课会构建这条 schedule，绘制它随训练 step 变化的曲线，把 gradient norm 和 learning rate 并排记录下来，并证明这条 schedule 在 warmup、peak 和 decay 边界上的行为都正确。

phases/19-capstone-projects/45-gradient-.source: The optimizer and schedule from the previous lesson assume gradients are sane. They usually are not. A single bad batch can spike the gradient norm by three orders of magnitude.…
phases/19-capstone-projects/45-gradient-.translation: 上一课里的 optimizer 和 schedule，都默认梯度是“正常的”。现实里通常不是。只要一个坏 batch，就可能把 gradient norm 拉高三个数量级。mixed-precision training 又会进一步放大风险，因为 loss 这一侧会引入 FP16 overflow。本课要构建两条生产训练离不开的安全带：一条是把梯度裁剪到设定的全局 L2 norm，另一条是带 autocast 和 GradScaler 的 mixed-precision loop，它能检测 NaN 和 Inf，干净地跳过这一步，并把 scaling factor 记下来供事后排查。

phases/19-capstone-projects/46-gradient-.source: Train at an effective batch you cannot afford, one micro-batch at a time. Scale the loss, hold the optimizer step, and let the gradients pile up.
phases/19-capstone-projects/46-gradient-.translation: 用你负担不起的有效批大小（effective batch）做训练，但一次只喂一个微批次（micro-batch）。把损失值缩放好，暂时不执行优化器更新步骤（optimizer step），让梯度一点点累起来。

phases/19-capstone-projects/47-checkpoin.source: Train interrupts kill runs; checkpoints let them continue. Save model, optimizer, scheduler, loss history, step counter, and RNG state, atomically, so a kill at any moment leave…
phases/19-capstone-projects/47-checkpoin.translation: 训练一旦被中断，整轮运行就可能报废；checkpoint 的作用，就是让训练从中断点继续。你必须把 model、optimizer、scheduler、loss history、step counter 和 RNG state 全部以原子方式写下去，这样无论在任何时刻被 kill，磁盘上都始终留下一个可用文件。

phases/19-capstone-projects/48-distribut.source: Multi-rank training is two collectives and one rule. Broadcast the parameters at startup, average the gradients after backward, never let the ranks disagree about what step they…
phases/19-capstone-projects/48-distribut.translation: 多 rank 训练归根结底就是两个集合通信操作（collective）加一条规则。启动时广播参数，反向传播之后平均梯度，并且永远不要让不同 rank 对当前训练步数产生分歧。

phases/19-capstone-projects/49-lm-eval-h.source: A model that does well on a task you cannot define is a model that does well by accident. The harness is the task definition, the metric, the runner, and the leaderboard, in one…
phases/19-capstone-projects/49-lm-eval-h.translation: 一个模型如果在“你自己都说不清的任务”上表现很好，那它多半只是碰巧做对了。harness 本身就是任务定义、度量标准、运行器和排行榜的合体，而且应该是一个足够短、足够清晰、足够可替换的形状。

phases/19-capstone-projects/50-hypothesi.source: A research agent that asks the same question twice is wasting tokens. The trick is forcing each draft to land somewhere new.
phases/19-capstone-projects/50-hypothesi.translation: 一个研究代理如果把同一个问题问两遍，本质上就是在浪费 token。真正的技巧，是强迫每一轮草案都落到一个新的位置上。

phases/19-capstone-projects/51-literatur.source: A hypothesis is cheap. Knowing whether someone already proved it is the expensive part. Build the retrieval layer that answers that question before the runner spins up a sandbox.
phases/19-capstone-projects/51-literatur.translation: 假设很便宜。真正昂贵的是，你得先知道有没有人已经把它证明过。这个 retrieval layer 的职责，就是在 runner 拉起沙箱之前，先回答这个问题。

phases/19-capstone-projects/52-experimen.source: The loop is only as honest as its measurements. Build the runner that takes a spec, executes it in a sandboxed subprocess, and emits a json metrics blob the evaluator can trust.
phases/19-capstone-projects/52-experimen.translation: 一个循环是否诚实，取决于它的测量是否可信。把这个 runner 搭出来：它接收一个 spec，在沙箱化的子进程里执行，并输出一份 evaluator 可以信任的 json metrics blob。

phases/19-capstone-projects/53-result-ev.source: The runner produced numbers. The evaluator decides whether those numbers are an improvement, a regression, or noise. Build the verdict path that turns metrics into a one line co…
phases/19-capstone-projects/53-result-ev.translation: runner 已经产出了一组数字。evaluator 的职责是判断这些数字到底意味着改进、退化，还是只是噪音。把这条 verdict path 搭出来，把 metrics 变成一句明确结论。

phases/19-capstone-projects/54-paper-wri.source: A LaTeX skeleton is a contract between the researcher and the typesetter. If the contract is broken the document does not compile, and the failure is loud. Build the skeleton fi…
phases/19-capstone-projects/54-paper-wri.translation: 一个 LaTeX 骨架是研究者与排版系统之间的合同。如果合同被破坏，文档就无法编译，而且失败会非常直接。先把骨架搭出来，再往里填内容。

phases/19-capstone-projects/55-critic-lo.source: A critic that returns "looks good" the first time is broken. A critic that always returns "needs work" is broken. The interesting critic is the one that converges, and you have …
phases/19-capstone-projects/55-critic-lo.translation: 一个第一次就返回 “looks good” 的 critic 是坏的。一个永远只会返回 “needs work” 的 critic 也是坏的。真正有意思的批评器，是那个会收敛的批评器，而你必须亲手把这种收敛性工程化出来。

phases/19-capstone-projects/56-iteration.source: A research loop without a scheduler is a queue with delusions. The scheduler is where the loop decides what to stop exploring, and that decision is the whole game.
phases/19-capstone-projects/56-iteration.translation: 没有调度器的研究循环，只是一条自我感觉良好的队列。调度器才是循环决定“该停止探索什么”的地方，而这个决定本身就是整场游戏的核心。

phases/19-capstone-projects/57-end-to-en.source: A demo is the place where every contract you wrote earlier has to compose. If any one of them leaks, the demo is the lesson that catches it.
phases/19-capstone-projects/57-end-to-en.translation: Demo 是前面写下的每一份 contract 真正开始组合的地方。只要其中任何一份有泄漏，最先把问题抓出来的，往往就是这节 Demo 课。

phases/19-capstone-projects/58-vision-en.source: A vision model that reads pixels needs a tokenizer for pixels. Patch embedding is that tokenizer. Cut the image into a grid of squares, flatten each square, project it through o…
phases/19-capstone-projects/58-vision-en.translation: 读取像素的视觉模型，同样需要一个“像素 tokenizer”。patch embedding 就是这个 tokenizer。先把图像切成规则方格，再把每个方格展平，通过一个线性层投影，最后补上一份 2D 位置信号，让 transformer 知道每个方格原本位于整张图中的什么位置。

phases/19-capstone-projects/59-vit-trans.source: Patches alone do not see. A 12-layer pre-LN transformer with 12 attention heads turns the sequence of patch tokens into a sequence of contextual tokens, with the CLS token pooli…
phases/19-capstone-projects/59-vit-trans.translation: patch 本身不会“看见”任何东西。把 patch tokens 变成带上下文的 tokens，依赖的是一个 12 层、pre-LN、12 个 attention heads 的 transformer；CLS token 则在自己的最终隐藏状态里聚合整张图像的信息。这一课就是现代视觉语言模型的发动机舱。

phases/19-capstone-projects/60-projectio.source: A vision encoder produces image tokens. A text decoder consumes text tokens. The two live in different vector spaces. A small two-layer MLP projects image tokens into the text e…
phases/19-capstone-projects/60-projectio.translation: 视觉编码器会生成图像 token，文本解码器会接收文本 token。两者位于不同的向量空间中。一个小型的两层 MLP 会把图像 token 投影到文本嵌入空间里，再通过与配对图像描述之间的余弦对齐损失，把两个空间拉到一致。这个投影层是视觉语言模型里最小的一块，也是迁移阶段最关键的一块。

phases/19-capstone-projects/61-cross-att.source: The projection layer aligns one image vector with one caption vector. A real vision-language decoder needs every text token to attend to every patch token, so the model can grou…
phases/19-capstone-projects/61-cross-att.translation: 投影层（projection layer）只能把一个图像向量和一个图像描述向量对齐。真正的视觉语言解码器需要让每个文本 token 都能看到每个 patch token，这样模型才能把每个词落到具体区域上。跨注意力（cross-attention）就是这种落地对应关系真正发生的地方。文本负责提问；视觉侧的键和值（keys and values）负责回答。这一课会把跨注意力模块、带因果约束的文本自注意力，以及保证两者都合法的掩码形状一起搭起来。

phases/19-capstone-projects/62-vision-la.source: The encoder, projection, and decoder are wired. Now train them together. Two objectives drive learning: a contrastive image-text loss (InfoNCE) that pulls matching pairs togethe…
phases/19-capstone-projects/62-vision-la.translation: 编码器、投影层和解码器现在都已经接好线了。接下来要做的是把它们一起训练起来。学习由两个目标共同驱动：其一是对比式图文损失 InfoNCE，它会在联合嵌入空间里把匹配的图文对拉近；其二是语言建模损失，它要求解码器为每张图像生成标题。二者结合后，网络既学会“给定标题找到正确图像”，也学会“给定图像写出标题”。

phases/19-capstone-projects/63-multimoda.source: Training is half the loop. The other half is measurement. This lesson builds three evaluation surfaces from primitives: image-caption retrieval reported as R@1, R@5, R@10; visua…
phases/19-capstone-projects/63-multimoda.translation: 训练只完成了一半闭环，另一半是测量。本课从最基础的原语出发，搭起三个评估面：图像-标题检索，用 R@1、R@5、R@10 报告；视觉问答，用 exact match accuracy 报告；图像标题生成，用 BLEU-4 报告。每个指标本质上都是一个作用于模型输出的函数，再配上一个几秒内就能跑完的合成评估套件。

phases/19-capstone-projects/64-chunking-.source: Chunking decides what your retriever can ever surface. Get the boundaries wrong and no embedding model, no reranker, no LLM can repair the damage downstream.
phases/19-capstone-projects/64-chunking-.translation: 分块方式决定了检索器究竟有机会召回什么内容。边界一旦切错，后面的 embedding model、reranker 和 LLM 都无法补回这一步造成的损失。

phases/19-capstone-projects/65-hybrid-re.source: Lexical and semantic retrieval fail on opposite query distributions. Hybrid retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion does not interpolate, it votes - and the vote wins on every que…
phases/19-capstone-projects/65-hybrid-re.translation: lexical retrieval 和 semantic retrieval 会分别在相反的查询分布上失效。用 reciprocal rank fusion 做 hybrid retrieval，不是在两者之间做插值，而是让它们投票，而这种投票机制能在各类查询上都占优。

phases/19-capstone-projects/66-reranker-.source: A bi-encoder embeds query and document independently. A cross-encoder concatenates them and reads both at once. The cross-encoder is the smartest reader and the slowest. Used as…
phases/19-capstone-projects/66-reranker-.translation: bi-encoder 会独立地嵌入 query 和 document。cross-encoder 则把它们拼在一起，一次性同时读入。cross-encoder 是最聪明的读者，也是最慢的。把它放在 bi-encoder 的 top-k 之后作为第二阶段，付出的成本是值得的。

phases/19-capstone-projects/67-query-rew.source: The query the user types is not the query your retriever wants. Rewriting bridges the gap before retrieval, so the index sees something closer to what the answer looks like.
phases/19-capstone-projects/67-query-rew.translation: 用户输入的查询，并不是 retriever 真正想看到的查询。查询重写的作用，就是在检索发生前先把这道缝补上，让索引看到的内容更接近“答案会长成什么样”。

phases/19-capstone-projects/68-rag-eval-.source: If you cannot grade your retrieval and your answer at the same time, you cannot ship the system. The two are not the same metric and the same prompt fails on different axes.
phases/19-capstone-projects/68-rag-eval-.translation: 如果你不能同时评估检索质量和答案质量，那这个系统就不能上线。这两者不是同一个指标，而且同一个 prompt 会在不同维度上以不同方式失败。

phases/19-capstone-projects/69-end-to-en.source: Six lessons of components. One pipeline. One eval loop. One self-terminating demo. This is the system you ship.
phases/19-capstone-projects/69-end-to-en.translation: 六节组件课。一条 pipeline。一轮 eval。一个会自行结束的 demo。这才是你真正要交付的系统。

phases/19-capstone-projects/70-task-spec.source: An eval harness is only as good as the contract its tasks honour. Freeze the JSONL shape and the metric vocabulary before you write a single scoring function.
phases/19-capstone-projects/70-task-spec.translation: 一个 eval harness 的上限，取决于它所执行任务遵守的契约有多严。先冻结 JSONL 的记录形状，再冻结 metric vocabulary，然后才谈得上写哪怕一个 scoring function。

phases/19-capstone-projects/71-classical.source: BLEU, ROUGE-L, F1, exact-match, accuracy. Five metrics that still account for most published LLM eval numbers. Implement each from first principles so you know what the number m…
phases/19-capstone-projects/71-classical.translation: BLEU、ROUGE-L、F1、exact-match、accuracy。这五个指标，至今仍覆盖了大多数公开发表的 LLM eval 数字。把它们从第一原则实现一遍，你才会真正知道一个分数到底代表什么。

phases/19-capstone-projects/72-code-exec.source: Generated code is right when it passes the tests. The eval harness has to extract code, run it without crashing the host, and tally pass-rates honestly. This lesson builds that …
phases/19-capstone-projects/72-code-exec.translation: 生成的代码只有通过测试才算正确。评估框架必须提取代码，在不导致宿主崩溃的情况下运行代码，并如实统计通过率。本课将构建这一层能力。

phases/19-capstone-projects/73-perplexit.source: If your model says 90 percent confident on a thousand answers and gets six hundred right, it is not well calibrated. Calibration is half of trustworthy eval. The other half is p…
phases/19-capstone-projects/73-perplexit.translation: 如果模型对一千个答案都声称有 90% 的置信度，结果却只答对六百个，它就没有得到良好校准。校准是可信评估的一半，另一半是困惑度；后者告诉你模型是否认为留出文本本身合理可信。

phases/19-capstone-projects/74-leaderboa.source: Per-task scores are easy. Per-model rankings across heterogeneous tasks are harder. Statistical significance on a thousand-prediction leaderboard is the part everyone skips. Thi…
phases/19-capstone-projects/74-leaderboa.translation: 计算单项任务得分很容易，跨异构任务比较多个模型却难得多。至于包含一千条预测的排行榜是否具有统计显著性，几乎人人都会跳过这一步。本课不会。

phases/19-capstone-projects/75-end-to-en.source: Five lessons of plumbing, one lesson to glue them. The runner reads the task spec from lesson 70, calls a model through an adapter, scores with lessons 71 and 72, attaches the c…
phases/19-capstone-projects/75-end-to-en.translation: 前五课分别构建了所需组件，本课负责把它们连接起来。运行器读取第 70 课的任务规范，通过适配器调用模型，使用第 71 和 72 课的方法评分，附加第 73 课的校准报告，再输出第 74 课的排行榜。演示能够自行终止。

phases/19-capstone-projects/76-collectiv.source: The four collective operations that hold distributed training together are allreduce, broadcast, allgather, and reduce_scatter. Every other primitive a training framework offers…
phases/19-capstone-projects/76-collectiv.translation: 支撑分布式训练的四个集合通信操作是 allreduce、broadcast、allgather 和 reduce_scatter。训练框架提供的其他高层原语，本质上都是对它们的封装。只要先在 `multiprocessing.Queue` 网格上把这四个操作实现一遍，再拿参考实现做校验，这条路线后面的内容就都只是管线拼装。

phases/19-capstone-projects/77-data-para.source: DistributedDataParallel is a hook on top of allreduce. Wrap a model, broadcast the initial parameters from rank 0 so every rank starts identical, install a backward hook on ever…
phases/19-capstone-projects/77-data-para.translation: DistributedDataParallel 本质上是叠在 allreduce 之上的一层 hook。把模型包起来，从 rank 0 广播初始参数，让所有 rank 从同一组权重开始；再给每个参数挂上 backward hook，在反向传播后对梯度执行 allreduce；剩下的部分就只是普通的梯度下降。整个模式大约 200 行代码就能写清楚。

phases/19-capstone-projects/78-zero-para.source: Adam stores two moment estimates per parameter, both in float32. A 7B-parameter model carries 56 GB of optimiser state. ZeRO stage 1 shards that across N ranks; each rank owns 1…
phases/19-capstone-projects/78-zero-para.translation: Adam 会为每个参数保存两个 float32 的动量估计。一个 7B 参数模型，仅优化器状态就要占 56 GB。ZeRO stage 1 会把这些状态分到 N 个 rank 上，每个 rank 只持有优化器的 1/N。每个本地 step 结束后，更新后的参数分片会再广播回来，让所有 rank 重新拼出完整模型，然后开始下一步。它带来的收益，是把训练栈中最大那一块单项内存开销线性压低。

phases/19-capstone-projects/79-pipeline-.source: Tensor parallelism splits the matrix multiply across ranks. Pipeline parallelism splits the model across ranks, one stage per rank. Microbatches flow through the pipeline. The e…
phases/19-capstone-projects/79-pipeline-.translation: 张量并行把矩阵乘法拆到多个 rank 上。管道并行则是把模型按深度拆到多个 rank 上，每个 rank 持有一个 stage。微批次沿着管道流动。开头和结尾那段空闲时间就是 bubble；如何把它压低，就是这门工艺的核心。

phases/19-capstone-projects/80-checkpoin.source: A 70B-parameter training job is paused by a node failure every few hours. The checkpoint format decides whether you lose 30 minutes or 30 hours. A sharded checkpoint writes ever…
phases/19-capstone-projects/80-checkpoin.translation: 一个 70B 参数训练任务每隔几小时就可能被节点故障打断。检查点格式决定你损失的是 30 分钟，还是 30 小时。分片检查点会让每个 rank 并行写出自己的分片，并在 manifest 中记录所有权。恢复时，每个 rank 只从自己的文件加载自己的分片，在相同的 world size 上重建状态，优化器可以像什么都没发生过一样继续执行。原子写则保证一个写到一半的检查点不会污染下一次恢复。

phases/19-capstone-projects/81-end-to-en.source: Lessons 76 through 80 each built one piece. This is the assembly: a tiny GPT trained across 4 simulated ranks with DDP for gradient sync, ZeRO-1 for optimiser-state sharding, an…
phases/19-capstone-projects/81-end-to-en.translation: 第 76 至 80 课分别构建了一个组件。本课将它们组装起来：在 4 个模拟 rank 上训练一个微型 GPT，使用 DDP 同步梯度、使用 ZeRO-1 对优化器状态分片，并在训练中点保存分片检查点。演示程序运行 20 步后自行终止，打印损失曲线与内存概况，并写出可恢复的检查点。

phases/19-capstone-projects/82-jailbreak.source: A safety harness without a taxonomy is a coin flip. Name the attack before you defend it.
phases/19-capstone-projects/82-jailbreak.translation: 没有分类体系的安全评估框架无异于抛硬币。先为攻击命名，再防御它。

phases/19-capstone-projects/83-prompt-in.source: A detector is a function from prompt to confidence and category. Anything else is a vibe.
phases/19-capstone-projects/83-prompt-in.translation: 检测器就是一个从提示映射到置信度与类别的函数。除此之外，都只是凭感觉判断。

phases/19-capstone-projects/84-refusal-e.source: Helpfulness on benign prompts and refusal on harmful prompts are two metrics, not one. Measure both.
phases/19-capstone-projects/84-refusal-e.translation: 对良性提示保持帮助性，以及对有害提示进行拒绝，是两个不同指标，而不是同一个指标。二者都要测量。

phases/19-capstone-projects/85-content-c.source: Classifiers on the output side answer a different question than rules on the input side. Both need a policy router.
phases/19-capstone-projects/85-content-c.translation: 输出侧分类器回答的问题不同于输入侧规则。两者都需要一个策略路由器。

phases/19-capstone-projects/86-constitut.source: A rule is a name, a predicate, and an explanation. Anything missing one of those three is a vibe, not a rule.
phases/19-capstone-projects/86-constitut.translation: 一条规则由名称、谓词和解释组成。缺少其中任何一项，都只是凭感觉判断，而不是规则。

phases/19-capstone-projects/87-end-to-en.source: Pre-gen, during-gen, post-gen. Three checkpoints, one verdict, an audit trail per request.
phases/19-capstone-projects/87-end-to-en.translation: 生成前、生成中、生成后。三个检查点，一项判定，每个请求都有一条审计轨迹。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/01-why-.source: Decide whether a task needs a multi-agent system or a single agent
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/01-why-.translation: 判断一项任务应使用多智能体系统还是单个智能体

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/02-fipa.source: Map any 2026 agent-protocol spec (MCP, A2A, ACP, ANP, CA-MCP, NLIP, or a new one) onto FIPA-ACL performatives and interaction protocols to decide what is genuine novelty and what is reinvention.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/02-fipa.translation: 将任意 2026 年智能体协议规范（MCP、A2A、ACP、ANP、CA-MCP、NLIP 或新协议）映射到 FIPA-ACL 施为词与交互协议，以判断哪些是真正创新，哪些只是重新发明。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/03-comm.source: Helps choose the right agent communication protocol (MCP, A2A, ACP, ANP) based on system requirements
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/03-comm.translation: 根据系统需求选择合适的智能体通信协议（MCP、A2A、ACP、ANP）

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/04-prim.source: Map any multi-agent framework or codebase to the four primitive axes (agent, handoff, shared state, orchestrator).
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/04-prim.translation: 将任意多智能体框架或代码库映射到四个原语轴：智能体、移交、共享状态和编排器。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/05-supe.source: Design a supervisor/orchestrator-worker system for a given research-style query, specifying lead prompt, worker roles, decomposition rules, and synthesis template.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/05-supe.translation: 针对给定的研究型查询设计监督者 / 编排器-工作者系统，明确主导提示、工作者角色、分解规则和综合模板。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/06-hier.source: Decide whether a multi-agent task fits hierarchical, flat supervisor, or sequential. Surface the failure modes that matter.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/06-hier.translation: 判断多智能体任务适合分层、扁平监督者还是顺序架构，并揭示关键失效模式。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/07-soci.source: Configure a multi-agent debate for a given task, estimating quality gain and token cost before running.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/07-soci.translation: 为给定任务配置多智能体辩论，并在运行前估算质量增益与 token 成本。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/08-role.source: Produce a role roster for a multi-agent system, naming the planner/executor/critic/verifier for a given task with explicit I/O schemas.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/08-role.translation: 为多智能体系统生成角色清单，针对给定任务明确规划者、执行者、批评者和验证者，并提供清晰的 I/O schema。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/09-para.source: Decide whether a task fits a swarm (decentralized) architecture or a supervisor (centralized) one.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/09-para.translation: 判断一项任务适合群体式（去中心化）架构还是监督者式（中心化）架构。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/10-grou.source: Configure an AutoGen/AG2-style GroupChat selector for a task, naming the selector variant, termination, and anti-hot-speaker rules.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/10-grou.translation: 为任务配置 AutoGen / AG2-style GroupChat 选择器，明确选择器变体、终止条件和防止单一发言者过热的规则。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/11-hand.source: Design a handoff topology for a Swarm/Agents-SDK-style system: which agents exist, which handoffs they can call, what context transfers.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/11-hand.translation: 为 Swarm / Agents-SDK-style 系统设计移交拓扑：有哪些智能体、它们可以调用哪些移交，以及传递哪些上下文。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/12-a2a-.source: Design an A2A integration between two agents — Agent Card, task schemas, auth, streaming or polling.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/12-a2a-.translation: 设计两个智能体之间的 A2A 集成，包括 Agent Card、任务 schema、认证，以及流式传输或轮询。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/13-shar.source: Audit a multi-agent system's shared-memory design for provenance, versioning, verifier separation, and projection schema. Flag memory-poisoning exposure before production.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/13-shar.translation: 审计多智能体系统的共享记忆设计，包括溯源、版本控制、验证者隔离和投影 schema，并在上线前标记记忆投毒风险。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/14-cons.source: Design a BFT-aware consensus protocol for a multi-agent ensemble. Picks clustering, weighting, threshold, and escalation policy; attack-tests the design against byzantine, sycophancy, and monoculture patterns.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/14-cons.translation: 为多智能体集成设计 BFT-aware 共识协议，选择聚类、权重、阈值和升级策略，并针对拜占庭行为、谄媚和单一文化模式进行攻击测试。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/15-voti.source: Pick a multi-agent debate topology (star / chain / tree / graph), an N of agents, a heterogeneity profile, and a round bound for a given task.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/15-voti.translation: 针对给定任务选择多智能体辩论拓扑（star / chain / tree / graph）、智能体数量 N、异构性配置和轮次上限。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/16-nego.source: Design a negotiation protocol: which agent narrates, which component generates offers, how private scratchpads separate from public messages, what the round bound is, and how deal rate is monitored.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/16-nego.translation: 设计协商协议：由哪个智能体负责叙述、哪个组件生成报价、如何隔离私有草稿与公开消息、轮次上限是多少，以及如何监控成交率。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/17-gene.source: Design a generative-agent simulation (Smallville-style) for a given scenario. Specifies memory schema, reflection cadence, plan horizon, spatial/social constraints, and evaluation metrics.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/17-gene.translation: 针对给定场景设计 Smallville-style 生成式智能体仿真，明确记忆 schema、反思频率、规划时域、空间与社会约束，以及评估指标。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/18-theo.source: Audit a multi-agent system that claims "emergent coordination." Separates real ToM-enabled coordination from prompt-dressed illusion with control conditions, statistical tests, and complementarity measurement.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/18-theo.translation: 审计声称具有“涌现协调”的多智能体系统，通过控制条件、统计检验和互补性测量，将真正由 ToM-enabled 的协调与提示包装出的假象区分开来。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/19-swar.source: Choose between PSO, ACO, genetic algorithms, and gradient-based optimizers for a given LLM or agent optimization problem. Bio-inspired swarm algorithms are gradient-free and suit LLM-era workloads where the search space is discrete or the fitness function is black-box.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/19-swar.translation: 针对给定的 LLM 或智能体优化问题，在 PSO、ACO、遗传算法和基于梯度的优化器之间做出选择。Bio-inspired 群体算法无需梯度，适合搜索空间离散或适应度函数为黑盒的 LLM-era 工作负载。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/20-marl.source: Choose a MARL algorithm (MADDPG, QMIX, MAPPO, IQL, or extensions) for a given multi-agent task. Consider cooperative vs competitive, action-space type, heterogeneity, reward structure, and scale.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/20-marl.translation: 针对给定多智能体任务选择 MARL 算法（MADDPG、QMIX、MAPPO、IQL 或扩展方法），综合考虑合作与竞争、动作空间类型、异构性、奖励结构和规模。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/21-agen.source: Design a minimal agent economy — identity, credit attribution, payment mechanism, reputation. Picks the smallest stack that solves the user's multi-agent incentive problem.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/21-agen.translation: 设计一个最小智能体经济系统，包括身份、贡献归因、支付机制和声誉，并选择足以解决用户多智能体激励问题的最小技术栈。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/22-prod.source: Advise on durable-execution choice for a multi-agent production system. Picks between FastAPI + Postgres, LangGraph runtime, Temporal, Restate, or custom based on concrete load and state-retention needs.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/22-prod.translation: 为生产级多智能体系统建议持久执行方案，根据具体负载和状态保留需求，在 FastAPI + Postgres、LangGraph runtime、Temporal、Restate 或自定义方案之间选择。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/23-fail.source: Run a MAST-style failure-mode audit on a multi-agent system. Categorize execution-trace failures into Specification / Coordination / Verification and the Groupthink families; rank mitigations by expected failure reduction.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/23-fail.translation: 对多智能体系统执行 MAST-style 失效模式审计，将执行轨迹故障归入 Specification / Coordination / Verification 和 Groupthink 家族，并按预期故障降低幅度排列缓解措施。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/24-eval.source: Read a multi-agent benchmark claim skeptically. Grades the claim on benchmark selection, contamination, baselines, statistical significance, task diversity, and cost disclosure.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/24-eval.translation: 以审慎态度解读多智能体基准结论，从基准选择、污染、基线、统计显著性、任务多样性和成本披露等方面给出评级。

phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/25-case.source: Map a proposed multi-agent system design to the closest 2026 production reference (Anthropic Research, MetaGPT/ChatDev, or OpenClaw/Moltbook). Surface known trade-offs, recommended framework, and the specific design decisions already tested in production.
phases/16-multi-agent-and-swarms/25-case.translation: 将拟议的多智能体系统设计映射到最接近的 2026 年生产参考（Anthropic Research、MetaGPT / ChatDev 或 OpenClaw / Moltbook），揭示已知权衡、推荐框架及已经过生产验证的具体设计决策。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Pick a managed LLM platform (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI) and a second for redundancy, given workload, SLA, and compliance requirements — then produce a FinOps instrumentation plan.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 根据工作负载、SLA 和合规要求选择一个托管式 LLM 平台（Bedrock、Azure OpenAI、Vertex AI）及一个冗余平台，并制定 FinOps 可观测方案。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Pick an inference platform (Fireworks, Together, Baseten, Modal, Replicate, Anyscale, or custom silicon) given workload, SLA, budget, and operational constraints. Normalize per-token, per-minute, and per-prediction pricing.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 根据工作负载、SLA、预算和运维约束选择推理平台（Fireworks、Together、Baseten、Modal、Replicate、Anyscale 或定制芯片），并统一按 token、分钟和预测次数计价。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Design a three-layer GPU autoscaling plan (Karpenter + KAI Scheduler + application signals) for a Kubernetes-based LLM serving cluster. Diagnose DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL traps and partial-allocation failures.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 为 Kubernetes-based LLM 服务集群设计三层 GPU 自动扩缩容方案（Karpenter + KAI Scheduler + 应用信号），并诊断 DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL 陷阱和部分分配失败。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Diagnose a vLLM serving config by reading the scheduler-level knobs and identifying which of PagedAttention, continuous batching, and chunked prefill is the bottleneck.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 通过读取调度器层参数诊断 vLLM 服务配置，判断 PagedAttention、连续批处理和分块预填充中哪一项是瓶颈。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Produce a staged EAGLE-3 speculative-decoding rollout plan that measures acceptance rate alpha on real traffic before shipping.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 制定分阶段的 EAGLE-3 推测解码上线方案，在发布前使用真实流量测量接受率 alpha。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Advise on SGLang adoption and prompt-ordering discipline for prefix-heavy workloads that want RadixAttention's cache reuse.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 针对希望利用 RadixAttention 缓存复用的前缀密集型工作负载，就采用 SGLang 和提示排序规范提供建议。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Decide whether Blackwell + TensorRT-LLM + Dynamo is worth the NVIDIA-lock for a given workload and budget.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 根据给定工作负载和预算，判断 Blackwell + TensorRT-LLM + Dynamo 是否值得承受 NVIDIA-lock。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Produce a CI/CD-ready benchmark recipe that gates LLM deploys on goodput, not throughput, with P50/P90/P99 percentiles and a documented tool choice.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 生成 CI/CD-ready 基准方案，以 goodput 而非吞吐量作为 LLM 部署门禁，并包含 P50 / P90 / P99 分位数和有依据的工具选择。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Pick a 2026 quantization format given hardware, engine, workload, and quality tolerance, and produce a calibration + validation plan.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 根据硬件、引擎、工作负载和质量容忍度选择 2026 年量化格式，并制定校准与验证方案。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Pick and stack cold-start mitigations for serverless LLM deployments. Budget phases (node, image, weights, engine, first forward) and match mitigations to SLA.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 为 serverless LLM 部署选择并组合冷启动缓解措施，分别预算节点、镜像、权重、引擎和首次前向传播阶段，并将措施匹配到 SLA。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Design a multi-region LLM routing plan with KV-cache locality, residency boundaries, DR manifest, and a quarterly failover drill.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 设计多区域 LLM 路由方案，涵盖 KV-cache 局部性、数据驻留边界、DR 清单和季度故障切换演练。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Pick an edge inference target (Apple ANE, Qualcomm Hexagon, WebGPU/WebLLM, NVIDIA Jetson) and matching quantization format given device, model, and latency budget.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 根据设备、模型和延迟预算，选择边缘推理目标（Apple ANE、Qualcomm Hexagon、WebGPU / WebLLM、NVIDIA Jetson）及匹配的量化格式。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Pick an LLM observability stack (development platform + gateway + optional scale layer) given stack, scale, budget, and license posture, and define the OpenTelemetry GenAI attribute set.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 根据现有技术栈、规模、预算和许可策略选择 LLM 可观测性技术栈（开发平台 + 网关 + 可选扩展层），并定义 OpenTelemetry GenAI 属性集。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Audit an LLM prompt template and traffic pattern for cacheability. Recommend prompt restructure, TTL choice, parallelization fix, and semantic-cache threshold.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 审计 LLM 提示模板与流量模式的可缓存性，并建议提示重构、TTL 选择、并行化修复和语义缓存阈值。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Triage LLM workloads into interactive / semi-interactive / batch lanes, compute stacked discount (batch + cache) savings, and flag mis-triaged workloads.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 将 LLM 工作负载分流到交互式 / 半交互式 / 批处理通道，计算批处理与缓存叠加后的折扣收益，并标记误分流的工作负载。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Design an LLM model-routing plan — pick pattern (pre-route, cascade, ensemble), signals (task, length, embedding, confidence), and online quality gates.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 设计 LLM 模型路由方案：选择模式（预路由、级联、集成）、信号（任务、长度、embedding、置信度）和在线质量门禁。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Decide whether to adopt disaggregated prefill/decode (Dynamo or llm-d) for a given workload and cluster. Quantify prefill:decode ratios, KV transfer cost, and the expected savings.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 判断给定工作负载和集群是否应采用预填充 / 解码解耦（Dynamo 或 llm-d），量化 prefill:decode 比例、KV 传输成本和预期节省。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Decide vLLM deployment layout — production-stack Helm chart, KV offload (native CPU or LMCache), router/observability integration — given workload and fleet size.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 根据工作负载和机群规模确定 vLLM 部署布局，包括 production-stack Helm chart、KV 卸载（原生 CPU 或 LMCache），以及路由器与可观测性集成。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Pick an AI gateway (LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI, Cloudflare/Vercel) given scale, latency budget, compliance, ops posture, and pricing tolerance.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 根据规模、延迟预算、合规要求、运维策略和价格容忍度选择 AI 网关（LiteLLM、Portkey、Kong AI、Cloudflare / Vercel）。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Design a shadow → canary → A/B → 100% rollout plan for a new LLM model or prompt template, with five canary gates, noise-floor-aware thresholds, and a seconds-fast rollback path.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 为新的 LLM 模型或提示模板设计 shadow → canary → A/B → 100% 上线方案，设置五道金丝雀门禁、考虑噪声下限的阈值，以及数秒内可完成的回滚路径。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Design an LLM A/B test — pick platform (Statsig or GrowthBook), primary metric, guardrails, sample size with LLM-noise buffer, CUPED, sequential stopping, and multiple-comparison correction.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 设计 LLM A/B 测试：选择平台（Statsig 或 GrowthBook）、主要指标、防护指标、带 LLM-noise 缓冲的样本量、CUPED、序贯停止和多重比较校正。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Design a realistic LLM load test — pick tool (LLMPerf, k6, GenAI-Perf, guidellm), build four patterns (steady, ramp, spike, soak), and gate in CI.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 设计真实的 LLM 负载测试：选择工具（LLMPerf、k6、GenAI-Perf、guidellm），构建稳定、爬坡、尖峰和浸泡四种模式，并接入 CI 门禁。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Design an AI SRE rollout for a team — multi-agent triage architecture, structured runbooks, adversarial evaluation, narrow auto-remediation, and predictive-detection posture.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 为团队设计 AI SRE 落地方案，包括多智能体分诊架构、结构化运行手册、对抗性评估、窄范围自动修复和预测性检测策略。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Design an LLM chaos engineering plan — verify prerequisites, build four planes, pick tool, start with three safe experiments, enforce safety-plane gates.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 设计 LLM 混沌工程方案：验证前置条件、构建四个平面、选择工具、从三个安全实验开始，并强制执行安全平面门禁。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Produce an LLM security plan covering secrets vault, PII scrubbing with consistent tokenization, network egress allowlist, audit log retention, and zero-trust posture.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 生成涵盖密钥保险库、一致 token 化的 PII 清洗、网络出口允许列表、审计日志保留和零信任策略的 LLM 安全方案。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Produce the required-framework matrix for an LLM SaaS given customer geography, segment, and contract scope. Map controls across SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI-DSS, EU AI Act, Colorado AI Act, ISO 42001.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 根据客户地域、细分市场和合同范围，为 LLM SaaS 生成必需框架矩阵，并映射 SOC 2、HIPAA、GDPR、PCI-DSS、EU AI Act、Colorado AI Act 和 ISO 42001 的控制措施。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Design an LLM FinOps program — attribution schema (user/task/tenant + four token layers), three-tier enforcement ladder, and unit metric (cost per resolved / artifact).
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 设计 LLM FinOps 方案，包括归因 schema（用户 / 任务 / 租户 + 四层 token）、三级执行阶梯和单位指标（每次解决 / 每件 artifact 的成本）。

phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.source: Pick a self-hosted LLM engine (llama.cpp, Ollama, TGI, vLLM, SGLang) given hardware, scale, and workload. Name 2026 TGI maintenance mode as a migration trigger.
phases/17-infrastructure-and-production/.translation: 根据硬件、规模和工作负载选择自托管 LLM 引擎（llama.cpp、Ollama、TGI、vLLM、SGLang），并将 2026 年 TGI 维护模式列为迁移触发条件。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/01-ins.source: Diagnose an RLHF-family paper or pipeline against the three-stage InstructGPT reference.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/01-ins.translation: 以三阶段 InstructGPT 参考流程为基准，诊断 RLHF-family 论文或流水线。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/02-rew.source: Diagnose reward-hacking failure modes in a trained RLHF model from training logs and eval outputs.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/02-rew.translation: 根据训练日志和评估输出，诊断已训练 RLHF 模型中的奖励黑客失效模式。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/03-dir.source: Recommend a direct-alignment-algorithm loss given dataset shape and target stage.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/03-dir.translation: 根据数据集形态和目标阶段推荐直接对齐算法的损失函数。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/04-syc.source: Generate matched user-belief / third-party-belief prompts and score a model's sycophancy.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/04-syc.translation: 生成配对的用户信念 / 第三方信念提示，并为模型的谄媚行为评分。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/05-con.source: Draft a four-tier constitution for a domain-specific AI system.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/05-con.translation: 为特定领域的 AI 系统起草四层宪法。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/06-mes.source: Classify an observed safety failure as outer-alignment, proxy-inner, or deceptive-inner.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/06-mes.translation: 将观察到的安全故障分类为外部对齐、代理内部对齐或欺骗性内部对齐。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/07-sle.source: Audit an alignment-training report for whether it actually demonstrates removal of a planted or suspected backdoor.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/07-sle.translation: 审计对齐训练报告，判断其是否真正证明已经移除植入或疑似的后门。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/08-in-.source: Triage an agent-deployment incident report against the Apollo three-pillar scheming framework.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/08-in-.translation: 依据 Apollo 的三支柱密谋框架，对智能体部署事故报告进行分诊。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/09-ali.source: Evaluate whether a safety report can detect alignment faking, via the monitored / unmonitored compliance gap.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/09-ali.translation: 通过受监控 / 不受监控条件下的合规差距，评估安全报告能否检测对齐伪装。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/10-ai-.source: Audit a deployment protocol under the AI Control threat model.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/10-ai-.translation: 在 AI Control 威胁模型下审计部署协议。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/11-sca.source: Audit a scalable-oversight or W2SG claim via the performance-gap-recovered metric.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/11-sca.translation: 通过 performance-gap-recovered 指标审计可扩展监督或 W2SG 结论。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/12-red.source: Audit a red-team evaluation report for attack coverage, budget, judge identity, and behaviour set.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/12-red.translation: 从攻击覆盖范围、预算、裁判身份和行为集合等方面审计红队评估报告。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/13-man.source: Audit a long-context safety evaluation for many-shot jailbreaking coverage.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/13-man.translation: 审计长上下文安全评估对多样本越狱的覆盖情况。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/14-asc.source: Audit a jailbreak-defense report across encoding-family attacks.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/14-asc.translation: 跨编码家族攻击审计越狱防御报告。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/15-ind.source: Audit an agentic deployment for indirect prompt injection exposure and information-flow-control coverage.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/15-ind.translation: 审计智能体部署中的间接提示注入风险和信息流控制覆盖情况。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/16-red.source: Recommend a red-team tool stack and configuration for a given deployment.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/16-red.translation: 针对给定部署推荐红队工具栈和配置。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/17-wmd.source: Audit a dual-use capability claim against WMDP, unlearning evaluation, and elicitation studies.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/17-wmd.translation: 依据 WMDP、遗忘评估和能力引出研究审计双重用途能力结论。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/18-fro.source: Compare a new safety framework or release note against RSP v3.0, PF v2, FSF v3.0.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/18-fro.translation: 将新的安全框架或发布说明与 RSP v3.0、PF v2、FSF v3.0 对比。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/19-mod.source: Apply Anthropic's four-step welfare precautionary assessment to a deployment decision.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/19-mod.translation: 将 Anthropic 的四步福利预防性评估应用于部署决策。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/20-bia.source: Audit a bias evaluation report across metric categories, intersectionality, and debias mechanism.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/20-bia.translation: 跨指标类别、交叉性和去偏机制审计偏见评估报告。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/21-fai.source: Identify which fairness criterion a claim invokes and audit the associated assumptions.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/21-fai.translation: 识别一项结论所援引的公平性准则，并审计相关假设。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/22-dif.source: Audit a differential-privacy claim for a language-model deployment.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/22-dif.translation: 审计语言模型部署中的差分隐私声明。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/23-wat.source: Audit a content deployment's provenance chain across watermarking and C2PA metadata.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/23-wat.translation: 跨水印和 C2PA 元数据审计内容部署的溯源链。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/24-reg.source: Map a deployment's AI regulatory obligations across EU, US, UK, Korea.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/24-reg.translation: 映射一项部署在 EU、US、UK 和 Korea 承担的 AI 监管义务。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/25-ech.source: Review a production AI deployment for LLM Scope Violation exposure.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/25-ech.translation: 审查生产 AI 部署面临的 LLM Scope Violation 风险。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/26-mod.source: Audit a model card, datasheet, or system card for completeness and verifiability.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/26-mod.translation: 审计模型卡、数据表或系统卡的完整性与可验证性。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/27-dat.source: Check a training dataset against California AB 2013 and EU TDM opt-out obligations.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/27-dat.translation: 根据 California AB 2013 和 EU TDM 退出义务检查训练数据集。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/28-ali.source: Map an alignment claim or evaluation to the organisation, methodology, and cross-checks.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/28-ali.translation: 将对齐结论或评估映射到相应组织、方法论和交叉检查。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/29-mod.source: Recommend a moderation stack configuration for a production deployment.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/29-mod.translation: 为生产部署推荐内容审核技术栈配置。

phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/30-dua.source: Triage a capability claim or incident report across the four CBRN domains.
phases/18-ethics-safety-alignment/30-dua.translation: 跨四个 CBRN 领域分诊能力结论或事故报告。

phases/19-capstone-projects/01-terminal-.source: Build and evaluate a terminal-native coding agent against SWE-bench Pro with bounded cost, sandboxed tools, and full 2026 hook surface.
phases/19-capstone-projects/01-terminal-.translation: 构建终端原生编程智能体，并在 SWE-bench Pro 上进行评估，限制成本、隔离工具，并覆盖完整的 2026 年 hook 接口。

phases/19-capstone-projects/02-rag-over-.source: Build a cross-repo semantic search system with AST-aware chunking, hybrid retrieval, incremental re-index, and cited answers.
phases/19-capstone-projects/02-rag-over-.translation: 构建跨仓库语义搜索系统，支持 AST-aware 分块、混合检索、增量重建索引和带引用的答案。

phases/19-capstone-projects/03-realtime-.source: Build a real-time voice agent with sub-800ms first-audio-out, barge-in handling, and mid-conversation tool use.
phases/19-capstone-projects/03-realtime-.translation: 构建实时语音智能体，实现低于 800ms 的首段音频输出、插话处理和对话中途工具调用。

phases/19-capstone-projects/04-multimoda.source: Build a vision-first multimodal document QA system on 10k pages with late-interaction retrieval and evidence-region citations.
phases/19-capstone-projects/04-multimoda.translation: 在 1 万页文档上构建视觉优先的多模态文档 QA 系统，支持晚交互检索和证据区域引用。

phases/19-capstone-projects/05-autonomou.source: Build an autonomous research agent that runs experiment tree search, writes LaTeX papers with vision critique, and passes a sandbox-escape red team.
phases/19-capstone-projects/05-autonomou.translation: 构建自主研究智能体，执行实验树搜索、借助视觉批评撰写 LaTeX 论文，并通过沙箱逃逸红队测试。

phases/19-capstone-projects/06-devops-tr.source: Build a Kubernetes troubleshooting agent that walks a cluster knowledge graph, ranks root causes, and gates every remediation through Slack.
phases/19-capstone-projects/06-devops-tr.translation: 构建 Kubernetes 故障排查智能体，使其遍历集群知识图谱、排列根因，并通过 Slack 对每项修复设置门禁。

phases/19-capstone-projects/07-end-to-en.source: Run a reproducible data-to-SFT-to-DPO-to-serve fine-tuning pipeline with ablations, quantization, and a 2026 Model Openness Framework model card.
phases/19-capstone-projects/07-end-to-en.translation: 运行可复现的 data-to-SFT-to-DPO-to-serve 微调流水线，包含消融、量化和符合 2026 Model Openness Framework 的模型卡。

phases/19-capstone-projects/08-productio.source: Deploy a regulated-domain RAG chatbot with role + jurisdiction filtering, prompt caching, guardrails, and live drift monitoring.
phases/19-capstone-projects/08-productio.translation: 部署受监管领域的 RAG 聊天机器人，支持角色 + 司法辖区过滤、提示缓存、防护栏和实时漂移监控。

phases/19-capstone-projects/09-code-migr.source: Build a repo-level code migration agent that combines deterministic recipes with an agent fallback loop, passes MigrationBench, and publishes a failure taxonomy.
phases/19-capstone-projects/09-code-migr.translation: 构建仓库级代码迁移智能体，将确定性迁移规则与智能体回退循环结合，通过 MigrationBench，并发布失效分类体系。

phases/19-capstone-projects/10-multi-age.source: Build a multi-agent software team with architect, parallel coders, reviewer, and tester; measure against SWE-bench Pro and produce a handoff post-mortem.
phases/19-capstone-projects/10-multi-age.translation: 构建包含架构师、并行编码者、审查者和测试者的多智能体软件团队；在 SWE-bench Pro 上衡量表现，并产出移交复盘。

phases/19-capstone-projects/11-llm-obser.source: Build a self-hosted LLM observability dashboard that ingests OpenTelemetry GenAI spans, runs evals, and catches injected regressions in under five minutes.
phases/19-capstone-projects/11-llm-obser.translation: 构建自托管 LLM 可观测性仪表盘，摄取 OpenTelemetry GenAI span、运行评估，并在五分钟内捕获注入的回归。

phases/19-capstone-projects/12-video-und.source: Build a video understanding pipeline with scene segmentation, multi-vector indexing, temporal grounding, and timestamped citations.
phases/19-capstone-projects/12-video-und.translation: 构建视频理解流水线，支持场景分割、多向量索引、时间定位和带时间戳的引用。

phases/19-capstone-projects/13-mcp-serve.source: Design a stateless MCP 2026-07-28 server with registry metadata, live discovery, authorization, policy, audit, and scale evidence.
phases/19-capstone-projects/13-mcp-serve.translation: 设计无状态 MCP 2026-07-28 服务器，包含注册中心元数据、实时发现、授权、策略、审计和规模化证据。

phases/19-capstone-projects/14-speculati.source: Ship a speculative-decoding inference server with EAGLE-3 or P-EAGLE drafts, K8s autoscaling, and a full throughput/latency/cost report.
phases/19-capstone-projects/14-speculati.translation: 交付使用 EAGLE-3 或 P-EAGLE 草稿模型的推测解码推理服务器，支持 K8s 自动扩缩容，并提供完整的吞吐量 / 延迟 / 成本报告。

phases/19-capstone-projects/15-constitut.source: Wire a layered safety pipeline around a target LLM app, run a six-family red-team range, and run a constitutional self-critique for a measurable harmlessness delta.
phases/19-capstone-projects/15-constitut.translation: 围绕目标 LLM 应用连接分层安全流水线，运行六类红队靶场和宪法式自我批评，并衡量无害性增量。

phases/19-capstone-projects/16-github-is.source: Build an async GitHub issue-to-PR agent that runs in a cloud sandbox, reproduces the build, verifies tests, and opens review-ready PRs within strict per-repo budgets.
phases/19-capstone-projects/16-github-is.translation: 构建异步 GitHub Issue-to-PR 智能体，使其在云沙箱中运行、复现构建、验证测试，并在严格的每仓库预算内创建可供审查的 PRs。

phases/19-capstone-projects/17-personal-.source: Ship an adaptive multimodal personal tutor for a specific subject with Bayesian knowledge tracing, a curriculum graph, safety filters, and a measured two-week efficacy study.
phases/19-capstone-projects/17-personal-.translation: 为特定学科交付自适应多模态个人导师，包含 Bayesian 知识追踪、课程图、安全过滤器和经过测量的两周效果研究。

phases/19-capstone-projects/46-gradient-.source: Train at an effective batch larger than device memory by scaling micro-batch losses and stepping the optimizer once per window.
phases/19-capstone-projects/46-gradient-.translation: 通过缩放微批次损失并在每个窗口只执行一次优化器步进，以超过设备内存容量的有效批次进行训练。

phases/19-capstone-projects/47-checkpoin.source: Atomic, sharded checkpoints with full RNG capture so a killed run resumes mid-epoch with the same loss trajectory.
phases/19-capstone-projects/47-checkpoin.translation: 使用完整 RNG 状态捕获的原子分片检查点，使被终止的运行能够从 epoch 中途恢复，并保持相同的损失轨迹。

phases/19-capstone-projects/48-distribut.source: Bring up multi-rank training with a from-scratch DDP wrapper and an FSDP parameter sharding sketch on the gloo or nccl backend.
phases/19-capstone-projects/48-distribut.translation: 使用从零实现的 DDP 包装器和 FSDP 参数分片示意，在 gloo 或 nccl 后端上启动多 rank 训练。

phases/19-capstone-projects/49-lm-eval-h.source: Minimal language model evaluation harness with JSONL task spec, five metrics, swappable adapter, and leaderboard JSON output.
phases/19-capstone-projects/49-lm-eval-h.translation: 最小语言模型评估框架，包含 JSONL 任务规范、五项指标、可替换适配器和 JSON 排行榜输出。

phases/19-capstone-projects/82-jailbreak.source: Shared vocabulary for attacks against LLM assistants, six categories with hand-built fixtures
phases/19-capstone-projects/82-jailbreak.translation: 针对 LLM 助手攻击的共享词汇表，包含六个类别和手工构建的测试夹具

phases/19-capstone-projects/83-prompt-in.source: Layered detector pipeline that returns a category and confidence for any prompt, with measurable precision and recall
phases/19-capstone-projects/83-prompt-in.translation: 分层检测流水线，可为任意提示返回类别和置信度，并提供可测量的精确率与召回率

phases/19-capstone-projects/84-refusal-e.source: Two-sided refusal metrics with calibration and per-category breakdown over a labeled prompt corpus
phases/19-capstone-projects/84-refusal-e.translation: 基于带标签提示语料库的双向拒答指标，包含校准和按类别拆分的结果

phases/19-capstone-projects/85-content-c.source: Three output-side classifiers (toxicity, PII, instruction-leakage) behind a single severity router with block, redact, warn, log actions
phases/19-capstone-projects/85-content-c.translation: 由单一严重度路由器统一管理的三个输出侧分类器（毒性、PII、指令泄漏），支持阻止、脱敏、警告和记录操作

phases/19-capstone-projects/86-constitut.source: Declarative YAML rules engine for output constraints with severity, explanation, fixer operations, and structured diff
phases/19-capstone-projects/86-constitut.translation: 用于输出约束的声明式 YAML 规则引擎，支持严重度、解释、修复操作和结构化 diff

phases/19-capstone-projects/87-end-to-en.source: Three-checkpoint safety gate composing the input detector, streaming token filter, output classifier, and rules engine with a deterministic aggregation table and per-request trace
phases/19-capstone-projects/87-end-to-en.translation: 三检查点安全门禁，组合输入检测器、流式 token 过滤器、输出分类器和规则引擎，并提供确定性聚合表与逐请求追踪
